name: patient_is_positive_for_hepatitis_c_virus_ribonucleic_acid_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently positive for hepatitis C virus ribonucleic acid (HCV RNA).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently positive for hepatitis C virus ribonucleic acid (HCV RNA).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently negative for hepatitis C virus ribonucleic acid (HCV RNA).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently positive for hepatitis C virus ribonucleic acid (HCV RNA).
